not_run: RivalRefusal: 'lace': LACE's output is a SAMPLER DRAW, not a function of the request alone: two calls on the same request return different features by construction. It is therefore not offered as a request->features callable. Its categorical head also has a closed vocabulary over the realised grid, so it cannot express an off-grid value at all - a structural limit of the method, documented at chlu.core.gen_request.DenseRequests, not one this spoke imposed. Hubs needing LACE on their own corners should ask this spoke to score those corners.
